additional_concerns: The nav > 0 scope restriction is not stated in the circular. It can return OUT_OF_SCOPE even for an otherwise covered Fund with an applicable SFC designation. Treating invalid or unresolved NAV as a measurement problem is an alternative requiring resolution.
The doubled exposure sum correctly implements the inclusive 50% threshold in exact common units; it does not impose a 100% threshold.
No exposure methodology is supplied despite the representation referring to one. Valuation, look-through, aggregation and double-counting treatment remain unresolved.
The assessment-time convention does not establish measurement dates, reassessment frequency, transition rules or designation expiry.
Global conflict blocking can prevent classification even when an independent route establishes it. This is an implementation evidence convention, not a requirement stated in the circular.
The three unbound dependency IDs have no mappings to named authorities. None can safely be assigned to a particular missing authority.
Footnote 1 separately references the UT Code 7.3 investment limit. That authority is missing and unmapped; investment-limit compliance is outside this classification question.
The separate LAF circular is missing and unmapped. It is unnecessary to implement the exclusion, but necessary for assessing LAF treatment beyond this question.
